weeks.headline: AI-related rounds keep coming up: 2 of 5 Google posts and a LinkedIn frontend post mention one, and Google has confirmed an AI-assisted pilot. Amazon OAs are also reported to include debugging an existing codebase.

companies.loop: One post lists the L5 loop as hiring assessment, domain knowledge, Googlyness, two DSA rounds and system design. Others mention an extra AI/ML conversation in team matching. Google has confirmed a Gemini-assisted code comprehension round pilot.
changes: Rounds named 'Hiring Assessment' and 'Domain Knowledge' in the L5 loop (1 of 5 reports)
AI-related round mentioned (2 of 5 reports), including a 45-minute conversational AI/ML interview in team matching with no coding
Press (Business Insider via Yahoo Finance, May 2026): Gemini allowed in a code comprehension round, piloting for junior and mid-level US roles
questions: Graph shortest path with fuel cost over N cities (FDE onsite)
Reading, debugging and optimizing existing code with an AI assistant
companies.prep: Practise reading and debugging unfamiliar code with and without an AI assistant, and keep DSA and system design sharp.

companies.loop: Posts describe an online assessment, then a four-round onsite mixing DSA, leadership principles, system design and OOP/LLD. Some candidates report OAs that include a code-repo debugging task alongside a coding question.
changes: OA includes a code-repo debugging problem (Spring Boot, Node, Django or C++) (2 of 7 reports)
Frontend Engineer OA reportedly has JavaScript coding plus system design prompts (1 of 7 reports)
questions: Event management and ticket booking system design
Debugging a category browsing engine in a code repo
companies.prep: Add practice on fixing bugs in an unfamiliar repo in your stack, plus a story bank for leadership principles.

companies.loop: Two senior frontend posts: one describes a phone screen focused on experience and projects, the other an upcoming 'Sr SWE Coding with AI' round in Bangalore, with the candidate asking whether JavaScript is allowed.
changes: A 'Coding with AI' round appears in the senior frontend loop (1 of 2 reports, candidate has not yet interviewed)
companies.prep: Practise building small frontend features in JavaScript with an AI assistant while explaining and verifying its output.
